annotations.title: Human Design connection between two people

description: Compares two people's charts: every channel the pair forms, grouped as electromagnetic (each brings one gate), companionship (both have it), dominance (one has it, the other neither gate) and compromise (one has it, the other one gate), with who holds what; the type, definition and defined centres of the combined chart; and each person's Type, Authority and Profile.

language.description: Language of the titles and summaries: en (default), nl (Dutch) or de (German).

birth_date.description: The first person's date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "1988-03-21".

birth_place.description: Where The first person's was born, as "City", "City, Country" or "City, Region, Country", e.g. "Utrecht, Netherlands", "Springfield, Illinois, USA". Used only to find the time zone.

birth_time.description: The first person's local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. "14:05". Leave out when unknown: noon is used and time_uncertainty_minutes defaults to 720.

name.description: A first name or label, only to tell the two people apart in the answer.

time_uncertainty_minutes.description: How far off the birth time may be, in minutes either way (e.g. 30 for "around half past two"). The result then says which parts of the chart could change.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Needed only when the place is not found; overrides the place's zone when given.

birth_date.description: The second person's date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "1988-03-21".

birth_place.description: Where The second person's was born, as "City", "City, Country" or "City, Region, Country", e.g. "Utrecht, Netherlands", "Springfield, Illinois, USA". Used only to find the time zone.

birth_time.description: The second person's local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. "14:05". Leave out when unknown: noon is used and time_uncertainty_minutes defaults to 720.
